scope: Public development case Kn14A and reflected/synthetic controls. Local proof validation, not a held-out accuracy estimate, a full-game winning proof, or installed-runtime verification.

baseline.rootStatus: Unproved for root-only and source line, both colours
baseline.memoryOnlyAttackingGuardRemoval: Rxc3+ remains unproved after 451 visits in both colours
baseline.cause: The leaf debits Qxe4 as 100cp, reducing the rook-for-knight gain from 180 to 80; independently Qxe4 allows Rxe8#. Correcting that liability alone still leaves an unresolved second king flight.

position.reflection: Reverse ranks, swap piece colours and side to move, reflect UCI ranks; no source-game independence is implied.

after.label: Mating Attack
after.valueMeaning: Verified minimum local material concession, including the 320cp interposer given for a 500cp rook; not an engine evaluation.
after.fullLineTimeline: Only the root Mating Attack; no duplicate free-rook capture label
after.wording: Blocks check and restores Rxe8#. All 27 replies allow a verified local material gain or mate. Not a forced-mate claim.

bounds.admission: Legal noncapturing, nonchecking interposition against one slider check, restoring an immediate mating threat
bounds.kingEvasions: At most two quiet king flights; each must preserve the exact nominated immediate mate. Every later checker must be legally captured and settled without another check or promotion.
bounds.materialLeaves: Existing same-square exchange and all-piece liability bounds. An off-square debit is removed only with a separate legal short-mate proof under the same budget.
bounds.unknowns: Cycles, draw claims, unresolved promotion or checking resources, terminal failures and exhaustion abstain. Existing attacking entry-point exclusions and modest-observation score gates are unchanged.

independentVerification.implementation: python-chess 1.11.2, independent legal replay, exact mate-in-one/checking-mate-in-two and optional same-square recapture minimax
independentVerification.input: Actual production certificate, not the memory-only prototype
independentVerification.mateLiabilityWitness: After Nc3 Rxc3+ Kxc3, the only profitable off-square capture is Qxe4 (+100 locally), independently refuted by Rxe8#. The same liability/refutation is checked after applicable king flights.
